title: Ferrari Circuit Racing
physics_constraints: max speed: 15 m/s, brake min: -3 m/s
circular track radius: 40 meters, width: 8 meters
4 checkpoints per lap, 3 laps to finish
AI speed: 8-12 m/s with random oscillation
grass friction penalty on track edges
difficulty_analysis: L5 challenges: (1) Loading an external race car model with GLTFLoader; (2) generating the circuit track and curbs; (3) physics simulation for WASD acceleration/braking/steering; (4) smooth third-person camera following; (5) valid-lap determination logic for 4 checkpoints × 3 laps; (6) an AI opponent that automatically follows the path; (7) real-time position tracking and race state machine; (8) a complete HUD system
